ASSESSMENT OF PDS OPERATIONS 

*41. +SHRI NABA CHARAN MAJHI: 
SHRIMATI ROOPKUMARI CHOUDHARY: 

Will the Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC 

DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state: 

(a)  whether the Government has conducted any assessment regarding the 

operation of the Public Distribution System (PDS) in aspirational districts of the 

country, State and district-wise particularly in Sirohi district of Rajasthan, North-

East India and various districts of Uttar Pradesh including Baghpat Lok Sabha 

Constituency; 

(b)  if so, the objectives and key findings of the said assessment along with the 

list of aspirational districts of Bihar; 

(c)  whether the Government has identified specific areas for improvement 

related to procurement, storage, distribution or grievance redressal under the 

PDS in the country, State and district-wise particularly in Chhattisgarh State and 

Tribal dominated districts State and district-wise like Palghar in Maharashtra;

(d)  if so, the details thereof particularly in respect of various districts of Uttar 

Pradesh including Baghpat Lok Sabha Constituency; 

(e)  the efforts being made to connect other eligible persons to the said 

scheme; 

(f)  the key findings and corrective actions of any assessment, survey or 

review conducted by the Central or State Governments regarding the operation 

of the PDS, availability of food grains, offtake/lifting, distribution, transparency, 

Aadhaar/e-PoS authentication and efficiency of the grievance redressal 

mechanism in the country particularly aspirational districts of Chhattisgarh; 

(g)  the details of the quantity of various grains distributed by the Government 

through the PDS during the last three years, year-wise and State-wise 

particularly in respect of Himachal Pradesh; and 

(h)  the details of beneficiaries receiving various grains through the PDS 

particularly in respect of Himachal Pradesh, grain-wise, year-wise and State-

wise?  

THE MINISTER OF CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC 
DISTRIBUTION; AND MINISTER OF NEW AND RENEWABLE ENERGY 
(SHRI PRALHAD JOSHI): 

(a) to (h) A Statement is laid on the Table of the House. 

STATEMENT 

(a) and (b)  The Department undertook an exercise to assess the functioning of 

PDS operations and implementation of Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna 

Yojana (PMGKAY) across all 112 Aspirational Districts between June-August 

2025. The objectives of the exercise were to assess the i) functioning of Fair 



03.12.2025   14 
 

Price Shops (FPS), ii) review procurement centre operations, iii) evaluate the 

infrastructure and efficiency of depots under the Food Corporation of India (FCI) 

and the Central Warehousing Corporation (CWC), iv) gather feedback from 

beneficiaries under PMGKAY and v) address grievances raised through 

CPGRAMS in these districts. In total, the exercise covered 113 Procurement 

Centres, 277 Fair Price Shops, 108 depots and interactions with 458 PMGKAY 

beneficiaries. The list of districts covered in the exercise including in the States 

of Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh, North-eastern states and Bihar are given in the 

enclosed Annexure- I.  

(c) to (f) Based on the assessment undertaken across all 112 Aspirational 

Districts, the Government has identified specific areas where further 

strengthening of procurement, storage, distribution, and grievance-redressal 

mechanisms would enhance overall efficiency of the Public Distribution System. 

  In procurement operations, the exercise found that the majority of 

procurement centres were functioning effectively, however certain centres would 

benefit from upgraded infrastructural facilities and ensuring timely payments for 

MSP to farmers.  

  In storage, while FCI and CWC depots largely met prescribed parameters, 

opportunities were noted for improving infrastructure, training on scientific 

storage practices for FCI and CWC officials and creating a self-assessment tool 

for State storage depots similar to the Depot Darpan portal.  

  In distribution, Fair Price Shops generally functioned satisfactorily and 

beneficiaries reported high levels of satisfaction with e-PoS based delivery; 

however, in a small number of cases, connectivity issues and device failures led 



03.12.2025   15 
 

to delays or multiple visits. The exercise identified scope to enhance beneficiary 

awareness on PMGKAY, fortified rice, and portability; provide e-receipts to 

beneficiaries ensure timely payment of commission to FPS dealers and ensure 

minimum facilities at FPSs.  

  In grievance-redressal, the assessment highlighted the need for more 

integrated grievance channels, improved functioning of Vigilance Committees 

and State Food Commissions and introduce AI- based solutions to gather 

feedback from beneficiaries. 

(g) The details of the quantity of various grains distributed by the Government 

through the PDS during the last three years, year-wise and State-wise are given 

in the enclosed Annexure- II. 

(h)  Details of beneficiaries receiving various grains through the PDS grain-wise, 

year-wise and State-wise are given in the enclosed Annexure- III.
